See also: recompensá and récompensa

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Deverbal from recompensar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [rə.kumˈpen.sə]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [rə.komˈpen.sə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [re.komˈpen.sa]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)
  • Hyphenation: re‧com‧pen‧sa

Noun

[edit]

recompensa f (plural recompenses)

  1. rewarding
  2. reward, recompense, compensation
  3. (law) bounty

Derived terms

[edit]
  • en recompensa de

Further reading

[edit]
  • “recompensa”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026

Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁe.kõˈpẽ.sɐ/ [he.kõˈpẽ.sɐ]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁe.kõˈpẽ.sɐ/ [he.kõˈpẽ.sɐ]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ʁe.kõˈpẽ.sɐ/ [χe.kõˈpẽ.sɐ]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁe.kõˈpẽ.sa/ [he.kõˈpẽ.sa]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁɨ.kõˈpẽ.sɐ/

  • Hyphenation: re‧com‧pen‧sa

Etymology 1

[edit]

Deverbal from recompensar (“to reward”).

Noun

[edit]

recompensa f (plural recompensas)

  1. the act of rewarding
  2. reward (something of value given in return for an act)
  3. bounty (reward for some specific act)
Synonyms
[edit]
  • (act of rewarding): recompensação, recompensamento
  • (reward): compensação, galardão, prémio
Derived terms
[edit]
  • caçador de recompensas
Related terms
[edit]
  • recompensação
  • recompensadamente
  • recompensado
  • recompensador
  • recompensamento
  • recompensar
  • recompensável

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

recompensa

  1. inflection of recompensar:
    1. third-person singular present indicative
    2. second-person singular imperative

Further reading

[edit]
  • “recompensa”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “recompensa”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Romanian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French récompenser.

Verb

[edit]

a recompensa (third-person singular present recompensează, past participle recompensat) 1st conjugation

  1. to reward

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /rekomˈpensa/ [re.kõmˈpẽn.sa]
  • Rhymes: -ensa
  • Syllabification: re‧com‧pen‧sa

Etymology 1

[edit]

Deverbal from recompensar.

Noun

[edit]

recompensa f (plural recompensas)

  1. reward, recompense
  2. bounty
  3. recompense, indemnification (act of compensation)
Derived terms
[edit]
  • cazarrecompensas

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

recompensa

  1. inflection of recompensar:
    1. third-person singular present indicative
    2. second-person singular imperative
